name: quirk-capability-radar-build
intent: Five-axis capability radar polygon builds from center with per-axis stagger to frozen profile values, then locks with PROFILE LOCKED readout announced via aria-live.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Show final polygon, PROFILE LOCKED readout, and aria-live lock announcement immediately

acceptance: Idle shows collapsed polygon at center with AWAITING SCAN
Analyse builds each axis in stagger order (90ms offset, 220ms per axis) to frozen values
Completion shows accent polygon, PROFILE LOCKED readout, and aria-live lock announcement
Replay resets polygon to center before rebuild
Reduced motion (prefers or data-force) shows final profile immediately
No network; labels and values match contract axes block
